Name: Kenneth's Starter Tools
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Starter Tools[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A simple mod that lets you start with better tools. No need to upgrade at Clint, you get them on day 1.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Comes in 4 versions:[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Kenneth's Copper Starter Tools[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Replaces your starting tools with copper tools. Axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, plus fiberglass rod. With a little mail from Kenneth.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Kenneth's Steel Starter Tools[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Replaces your starting tools with steel tools. Axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, plus fiberglass rod. Stronger and faster.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Kenneth's Gold Starter Tools[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Replaces your starting tools with gold tools. Axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, golden scythe, plus fiberglass rod. Breaks bigger areas.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Kenneth's Iridium Starter Tools[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Replaces your starting tools with iridium tools. Axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, iridium scythe, plus iridium rod. Best tools from day 1.[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]How to use:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Install only one version. You can install all but not recommended since they will overlap. Just pick one you want.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Safe to uninstall:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Once you got the tools, save your game or sleep for a day to save. After that you can safely uninstall the mod and keep the tools.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements: SMAPI, Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Works with any farm map.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made for fun, play how you want.[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: Full iridium from the start. You get iridium axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can, plus iridium scythe and iridium rod. For players who just want endgame tools immediately.

Manifest.Name: Kenneth's Iridium Starter Tools
Manifest.Description: Start with Iridium Tools on Day 1 - The ultimate power for the ultimate farmer! Perfect for large farms like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm and more!
Manifest.Author: KennethFiel
